field_decisions.value: Requires data-center developers to submit energy plans protecting residential ratepayers and assuring energy needs can be met now, in the near term and long term without additional costs to other utility ratepayers. Directs the Public Service Commission not to allow utilities to increase rates paid by other ratepayers to recover costs caused by data-center development and operation. Directs the Energy and Environment Cabinet to deny permit applications where a data center would negatively affect listed environmental resources and requires compliance with applicable environmental laws and public-engagement requirements. Requires tax and community-engagement commitments and preserves local-community decisions on data-center operations. The order does not establish a categorical moratorium or repeal all statutory incentives.
